dataset_status.note: This file contains a small illustrative starter set (one outcome per grade x domain) for development/demo purposes. It has NOT been verified against, or copied from, the official NIPUN Bharat / FLN Government of India outcome codes. All ids are prefixed 'internal_' and must never be presented to end users as official government reference codes. Replace this file with the verified official dataset before claiming NIPUN compliance.
